Message:
perf trace: Call machine__exit() at exit

Otherwise 'perf trace' leaves a temporary file /tmp/perf-vdso.so-XXXXXX.

  $ perf trace -o log true
  $ ls -l /tmp/perf-vdso.*
  -rw------- 1 root root 8192 Nov  8 03:08 /tmp/perf-vdso.so-5bCpD0
